title: New Therapeutic Approach Against BK Virus Infection Based on Monoclonal Antibodies
official: New Therapeutic Approach Against BK Virus Infection Based on Monoclonal Antibodies
summary: BK virus (BKV) infection has a major negative impact on transplant recipients. No BKV-specific antiviral therapy is available, so there is an urgent need to develop new anti-BKV preventive and therapeutic strategies.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* BK positive
* adult
* ok to participed to research

Exclusion Criteria:

* under guardianship
* under curatorship
* opposed to research
* deprived of liberty

sites.f: Service de Virologie - CHU Strasbourg - France
